incident-bot: :rotating_light: Pager triggered: embeddings-queue-p99-latency high in eu-west-1. Alert groups: embeddings-queue, kv-cache. Link: https://monitoring.redwood.internal/alerts/emb-4229991234

Alex Nguyen: I'm taking this as primary. Summary: p99 latency jumped ~3x over baseline starting 10m ago, affects generation and embeddings. Some customers seeing timeouts (~504). Not a full outage but visible customer impact.

Maria Patel: on it as secondary, joining channel. Any recent deploys?

deploy-bot: deployment "embed-runtime-v3.2.1" promoted to eu-west-1 at 4229989000 by jenkins (CI). No rollback events.

Sam O'Connor: I'm seeing queue backlog on node pool emb-q-021.. emb-q-024. Prefetch edges show heavy KV cache misses.

Alex Nguyen: Good catch. Initial mitigations attempted: - increased consumer concurrency on emb-workers from 8 -> 12 (rolling) - flushed small prefix cache on two nodes (emb-q-022/023) to force cold-reload for stuck entries.

Jess Rivera: Support ticket #SUP-18934 flagged by customer ACME Corp with regen failures and 10-30s extra latency. We're pre-notifying customers for potential degraded performance.

Maria Patel: Can you paste the commands you used to increase concurrency? I want to reproduce on emb-q-024.

Alex Nguyen: Ran:

```bash
kubectl -n embeddings set env deploy/emb-worker CONCURRENCY=12 --context=eu-west-1
```

Then verified pods restarted and `kubectl get pods -n embeddings -o wide` showed new pods come up on different nodes.

Sam O'Connor: After concurrency bump backlog dropped ~20% on emb-q-021/022 but emb-q-024 still high. I'm going to scale the pool by +2 replicas temporarily.

Sam O'Connor: Scale command: `kubectl -n embeddings scale deploy/emb-worker --replicas=18 --context=eu-west-1`

deploy-bot: scale event recorded at 4229992005, autoscaler still enabled.

Maria Patel: Noticed increased Redis latency for small GETs around the same time (p99 redis GET ~45ms -> 200ms). Could be a tail issue with certain keys. Link to logs: https://logs.redwood.internal/q/emb-4229991234

Alex Nguyen: That's consistent with KV-cache evictions we saw. Can someone run `redis-cli --latency-history` on the primary? Also check eviction metrics: `redis_info keyspace_hits/ misses/evicted_keys`.

Maria Patel: Running latency history now. Early output shows intermittent stall at ~4229991100 and 4229991900. Evictions spiked right after large batch writes from prefetch job.

Jess Rivera: I pushed a note to the ACME contact: "We're mitigating an elevated latency issue affecting regenerations in eu-west-1; our engineers are actively scaling and investigating root cause. We'll follow up with timeline and ETA." :thumbsup:

Sam O'Connor: Temporary mitigation plan: 1) keep concurrency + scale up pool by 2 reps, 2) add rate-limiter on background prefetch job to reduce burst writes, 3) if Redis tail persists, failover to read-replica or throttle writes.

Alex Nguyen: Agree. Maria, can you throttle prefetcher? Where's the config?

Maria Patel: Prefetcher runs as cronjob `emb-prefetch` with env PREFETCH_RATE. Will patch to set PREFETCH_RATE=0.5 (half throughput) and apply.

Maria Patel: Patch applied at 4229992550: `kubectl -n embeddings set env job/emb-prefetch PREFETCH_RATE=0.5 --context=eu-west-1`. Job restarted, next run delayed by 2m.

Sam O'Connor: After prefetch throttle, Redis p99 dropped to ~70ms and queue backlog is stable but not fully recovered. Customer regen success rate increased to 96% from 82%.

Alex Nguyen: Good. Remaining work: - watch for recurrence over next 45m - assess if we need to promote a read-replica and migrate heavy reads - prepare rollback of embed-runtime if correlation shows deploy is causal.

Jess Rivera: Support will keep customers updated. Open tickets: SUP-18934 (ACME) and SUP-18936 (BetaApp). I'll annotate ticket with mitigations and expected follow-up.

incident-bot: Incident assigned: incident-emb-euw-4229991234. Severity: Sev2. Runbook: https://runbooks.redwood.internal/embeddings-kv-eviction

Alex Nguyen: Notes for next shift (handoff checklist):
- Primary/secondary: Alex (primary until 4229994600), Maria (secondary). After handoff Sam will take primary for overnight.
- Active alerts: embeddings-queue-p99-latency, redis-evictions-rate-high.
- Mitigations in progress: concurrency bump +2, pool scaled +2, prefetch throttle applied.
- Customer impact: regen latency spikes, intermittent 504s for some customers; support tickets noted.
- Runbook pointers: embeddings-kv-eviction runbook (link above), rollback guide https://runbooks.redwood.internal/embed-runtime-rollback.
- Commands & verification: include `kubectl -n embeddings get hpa,deploy,po` and watch dashboards: https://dashboards.redwood.internal/d/embeddings/eu-west-1-overview

Maria Patel: Coverage gap note: On-call rotation tomorrow 02:00-06:00 UTC only has single engineer on deck due to holiday; recommend scheduling an extra on-call shadow if we expect instability overnight. I flagged PagerDuty to request backup.

Alex Nguyen: Good call. Jess, can you open a PSR to request backup from rotations for 02:00UTC?

Jess Rivera: Done at 4229993450 - PSR-877 issued to rotations team requesting backup for 02:00-06:00 UTC.

Sam O'Connor: I'll stay online until 4229994620 to watch metrics and finalize handoff. If things are quiet by then I'll hand primary to the overnight on-call (TBD).

Alex Nguyen: Final checklist before handoff: - Confirm redis evictions trend downward for 30m - No new customer 504s in last 15m - Confirm prefetch job runs at reduced rate without spikes - Prepare rollback PR if further regressions match deploy timeline.

Maria Patel: I'll keep alerts quieted to avoid noise but with escalation enabled. Will post a summary if anything changes.

Sam O'Connor: Quick note for overnight: if p99 > 2.5x baseline again, trigger read-replica failover (steps in runbook) and notify rotations.

Alex Nguyen: Thanks team. Handoff complete in ~15m, tracker incident-emb-euw-4229991234 will be updated. :white_check_mark:

Jess Rivera: Leaving channel but monitoring tickets. Ping me if we need to escalate to AMs.

Maria Patel: I'll keep a watch. Good handoff.

Sam O'Connor: signing off at 4229994620 (handover to overnight).

incident-bot: Incident status: monitoring. Next check-in scheduled in 20 minutes.
